observations: Current atlas uses a long purple/gold-trimmed mage-like coat/cape, dark trousers and plated silver knee/boot armor with star motifs. These garments materially differ from WB2003 main model.

WB2003 source has purple short top/skirt and tall purple boots with broad silver-blue cuffs, exposed hands, high silver-blue collar/green gem, two bracers/green gems and one anatomicalRIGHT upper-arm band. Gold long-coat trim and armored kneepads are unsupported by that model.
Current sprite is a previous project variant with major outfit/proportion drift; it does not establish reference fidelity for the new CGs. Original file is preserved.

reference.provenance: WarnerBros Animation2003 MAINMODEL BODYTURNS, FINAL11/19/02, studio sheet hosted via Wiki mirror, not a new DCpublisher-host download.
